# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen in Volume 1, seventeen in Volume 2, and around eighteen in Volume 3  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v3 c1 P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a very handsome girl with a brilliant complexion, large blue eyes, and long, thick golden hair. She has a plump, showy figure, and in her later years becomes very thin and pale with a hectic flush due to illness.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, and hysterical at times, with a strong inclination toward vanity and sentimentality. She is absorbed in clothes, beaux, and flirtations, constantly boasting about her admirers and preoccupied with romance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## Traits

- Sentimental and vain  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>
- Obsessed with boys and suitors  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c11 P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008)</sub>

## Abilities

- Embroidery and fancy work  <sub>[v3 c11 P2](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0002), [v3 c14 P33](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0033)</sub>

## Goals

- To have many admirers and a gay time before settling down to marriage  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c11 P53](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0053), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)</sub>

## History

Ruby Gillis grew up in Avonlea as one of Anne Shirley's classmates and friends. She attended Queen's Academy to study for a teaching license and joined the Story Club and the Village Improvement Society. After graduating from Queen's, she taught at the Carmody school for a time and later obtained the White Sands school. During a winter teaching term, she suffered an attack of congestion that developed into galloping consumption. Despite her failing health, Ruby maintained a bright, hopeful facade throughout the summer, denying the severity of her illness. Eventually, she admitted her fear of death to Anne during a quiet evening at her home. Shortly afterward, Ruby passed away peacefully in her sleep and was buried in the Avonlea graveyard.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P19](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0019), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_

## Quotes

> I’m not afraid but that I’ll go to heaven, Anne. I’m a church member. But—it’ll be all so different. I think—and think—and I get so frightened—and—and—homesick.  <sub>[v3 c14 P13](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0013)</sub>

> I want to live. I want to live like other girls. I—I want to be married, Anne—and—and—have little children.  <sub>[v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)</sub>

> I’ve been fighting so hard to live—and it isn’t any use—I have to die—and leave everything I care for.  <sub>[v3 c14 P15](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0015)</sub>

> I’m perfectly well. I never felt better in my life.  <sub>[v3 c11 P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057)</sub>
